🎬 Bruiser (2022) — Drama

Bruiser (2022) follows Darious, a teenager who spends the summer questioning his relationship with his strict father and searching for a sense of identity. After meeting a mysterious man named Porter, Darious discovers a different perspective on masculinity, strength, and what it means to stand up for yourself.

As Darious becomes closer to Porter, the relationship begins to challenge everything he has been taught about being a man. At the same time, tensions with his father continue to grow, forcing Darious to confront difficult emotions and questions about their complicated relationship.

The film explores themes of fatherhood, masculinity, identity, anger, forgiveness, and emotional vulnerability. Rather than presenting strength as simply being tough or intimidating, Bruiser examines the importance of understanding emotions and breaking unhealthy patterns passed down through generations.

Darious's journey shows how difficult it can be for a young person to define themselves while dealing with expectations from the people around them. His relationships with both men offer contrasting ideas about strength and responsibility, giving the story a deeper look at what it means to grow up.

More than just a coming-of-age drama, Bruiser is a thoughtful story about family, identity, and learning that true strength can also come from vulnerability and understanding. ❤️‍🩹

💬 Do you think people can break the unhealthy patterns they learned from their parents? Let us know in the comments! 👇
